import pandas as pd

# Read source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length2_24/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length2_24/training_1.csv", index_col=0)

# Join Source0 and Source1 on movie_id
joined = pd.merge(source0, source1, on="movie_id", how="inner")

# Group by title and aggregate: count of ratings as size, average of ratings as mean
agg = joined.groupby("title", as_index=False).agg(
    size=pd.NamedAgg(column="rating", aggfunc="count"),
    mean=pd.NamedAgg(column="rating", aggfunc="mean")
)

# Ensure correct dtypes as per target schema
agg["title"] = agg["title"].astype(str)
agg["size"] = agg["size"].astype(int)
agg["mean"] = agg["mean"].astype(float)

# Write the result to the target path without the index column
agg.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_24/target_multisource.csv", index=False)
